semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Security & access control
subtitle: Signed sessions, roles, origin checks, limits and explicit access errors

nodes.label: Incoming protected request
nodes.description: Applicable mutation handlers apply guards locally.

nodes.label: JWT and stored session
nodes.description: Check HS256, issuer, audience, jti hash, session expiry and verified user record.

nodes.label: Required role / ownership?
nodes.description: Owner admin APIs use normalized OWNER/ADMIN; legacy staff routes have different literal role checks.

nodes.label: Origin and body limits
nodes.description: Origin allowlist and streamed body cap are helpers explicitly called by participating routes.

nodes.label: Rate limit counters
nodes.description: limits collection tracks scoped counts in a sixty-second window; exceeding threshold returns 429.

nodes.label: Execute guarded handler
nodes.description: Handlers parse Zod input and authorize the applicable resource before service mutations.

nodes.label: Safe success / error response
nodes.description: api() maps Zod to 400, duplicate records to 409, ApiError to its code, unknown service errors to 503; redacts environment secrets.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.

These protections are not universal middleware. API inventory lists checks found per handler; several routes use custom response/error wrappers. Broad origin allowances and inconsistent legacy role checks are documented review items, not silently corrected.
